caption: A macro close-up frames a fuzzy, fibrous reddish-pink mound rising against a near-black background. The framing remains essentially fixed, and tiny bright specks dot the upper ridge as the gloss spreads. A small blue circular spot rests near the center of the mound, while bluish-green fringes line its lower edges. The surface is already wetting and shifting at the start, and this slow change continues without resolution. On the right side, a darker-red bulge gradually smooths into a glossier, more dome-like form. At the lower center, a pale amber feature gains a clearer droplet highlight over time, taking on a fuller sheen. The overall exposure drifts too: the mound reads more orange-pink at first and deepens into a more saturated red with stronger specular glints later. These local surface changes unfold steadily, while the central blue spot and the blue-green base fringes stay in place, marking one continuous, unresolved moment of a slow wetting process.
relations: Surface wetting on the mound causes gloss to spread and bright specks to dot the upper ridge.
The right-side darker-red bulge gradually smooths into a glossier, more dome-like form.
The lower-center pale amber feature gains a clearer droplet highlight and fuller sheen over time.
Exposure drift shifts the mound from orange-pink to saturated red while the central blue spot and blue-green fringes persist.
